home.paragraph1: Everything that enters our eyes eventually reaches the depths of the soul, quietly shaping the world we see.
home.paragraph2: The words we've read, the images we've watched, the moments that once moved us — in the end, they all become part of who we are.
home.roomHint: Books, films, series and anime can all live together here. No sorting required — just keep the stories you love.
home.tagline: A place for every story you've seen.

intro.alt: A small traveler climbs red-brick stairs, pushes open a wooden door and enters a castle library lounge with a moonlit arched window, a fireplace and reading nooks.
intro.stillAlt: A castle library lounge under a moonlit arched window: fireplace, tiered bookshelves and reading nooks.
